main.description: Copy fields of the authenticated user's app.bsky.actor.profile record onto their social.coves.actor.profile record. Values are re-read from the user's PDS; the input names fields only. Avatar and banner are copied as blob refs, never re-uploaded. Also records the import offer as dismissed; that step is best effort, and its failure does not fail the import.

uri.description: AT-URI of the written profile record

cid.description: CID of the written profile record

imported.description: Requested fields that were written. A requested field absent on the Bluesky profile is skipped.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: The request is not authenticated.

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: The session store is temporarily unavailable; retry.

errors.name: MissingCredentials
errors.description: The session has no PDS host; sign in again.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: fields is empty, repeats a field, or names an unknown field, the body is not valid, or the user's PDS rejected a request as invalid.

errors.name: NothingToImport
errors.description: The user has no Bluesky profile record, or none of the requested fields is importable from it. Nothing was written.

errors.name: SessionError
errors.description: The user's PDS session could not be restored; sign in again.

errors.name: SessionBusy
errors.description: Another request is using the session; retry.

errors.name: AuthExpired
errors.description: The user's PDS session expired while reading or writing a profile record; sign in again.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: The Coves profile record changed while importing; retry.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The user's PDS reported a record or repo as missing during the write.

errors.name: PermissionDenied
errors.description: The session does not have permission to read or write the profile record.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The user's PDS rate-limited the import; retry later.

errors.name: PayloadTooLarge
errors.description: The request body or the profile record exceeds a size limit.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The user's PDS answered with a server error or an unusable response (over 1 MiB, undecodable, or a 404 without an XRPC error).

errors.name: PDSError
errors.description: The user's PDS could not be reached or failed to write the profile record.

errors.name: Timeout
errors.description: The request timed out.

errors.name: RequestCanceled
errors.description: The request was canceled.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The PDS client could not read the profile records.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: The response could not be encoded.

errors.name: MethodNotAllowed
errors.description: The request method is not POST.
